verse.name: v1a
verse.lines: O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is Your Name in all the earth

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is Your Name in all the earth

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The heavens declare Your greatness
The oceans cry out to You

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
The mountains,
they bow down before You

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines: So I'll join with the earth and I'll give my praise to You

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I will worship You, I will worship You
I will worship You, I will worship You

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
We will worship You
We will worship You
